a3.speaker: Metal Gear
a3.en: I-I-I'm all right. I think. My speech circuits seem a little scrambled.

a5.speaker: Metal Gear
a5.en: Randam pushed us into the vent and blew himself up.
cards: Randam pushed us|into the vent and blew himself up.

a7.speaker: Metal Gear
a7.en: Gillian, that blast must have destroyed Queen Hospital.
cards: Gillian, that blast|must have destroyed Queen Hospital.

a8.speaker: Gillian
a8.en: The solid duct absorbed the blast. Without Randam, we'd be dead. Randam!

a9.speaker: Metal Gear
a9.en: Gillian, there's no time to grieve. We must get back and junk Cunningham, or Harry and Mika will be in danger, too.
cards: We must get back|and junk Cunningham,
or Harry and Mika|will be in danger, too.

aa.speaker: Gillian
aa.en: We have to keep our promise to Randam.
cards: We have to keep our|promise to Randam.

ab.speaker: Gillian
ab.en: First, we need a way out of here!
cards: First, we need a way|out of here!

ac.speaker: Metal Gear
ac.en: But I can't see anything. What now?
cards: But I can't see|anything. What now?

af.speaker: Gillian
af.en: So Queen Hospital was connected to the Tube Liner.
cards: So Queen Hospital|was connected to|the Tube Liner.

b0.speaker: Metal Gear
b0.en: Yes. The Snatchers used these tunnels to move around underground.
cards: Yes. The Snatchers|used these tunnels|to move around|underground.

b1.speaker: Metal Gear
b1.en: They can't stand ultraviolet light. They must have used these tunnels to stay out of the sun.
cards: They must have used|these tunnels to|stay out of the sun.

b2.speaker: Metal Gear
b2.en: Why didn't we realize it? Subway lines run all over the city. Now that they're abandoned, they can move around unseen.
cards: Why didn't we|realize it? Subway|lines run all over|the city.
Now that they're|abandoned, they can|move around unseen.

b3.speaker: Gillian
b3.en: Of course! That figure at the factory where Gibson died vanished into these tunnels!

b4.speaker: Metal Gear
b4.en: Yes. The Tube Liner also runs under that factory. That explains the sand that fell from the factory into the air vent.
cards: Yes. The Tube Liner|also runs under|that factory.
That explains the|sand that fell from|the factory into|the air vent.

b5.speaker: Gillian
b5.en: I see. So that's how they did it. They moved around without being seen and stayed out of the sunlight!

They moved around|without being seen|and stayed out of|the sunlight!

b6.speaker: Metal Gear
b6.en: No wonder it took so long to find the Snatchers.
cards: No wonder it took|so long to find the|Snatchers.

b7.speaker: Gillian
b7.en: Let's follow the Tube Liner tracks! We might find a way out at the nearest station.
cards: We might find a way|out at the nearest|station.

b9.speaker: Metal Gear
b9.en: But it doesn't look like a station.
cards: But it doesn't look|like a station.

bc.speaker: Gillian
bc.en: I don't know. Well, let's climb up and see.
cards: I don't know. Well,|let's climb up and|see.

be.speaker: Metal Gear
be.en: What a strange place to end up. Oh! This is...
cards: What a strange|place to end up.|Oh! This is...

c0.speaker: Gillian
c0.en: Freddy used this bathtub to reach the tunnels. That explains what happened before!
cards: Freddy used this|bathtub to reach|the tunnels.

c1.speaker: Metal Gear
c1.en: After we junked Lisa, Freddy entered the room without using the front door?
cards: Freddy entered the|room without using|the front door?

c2.speaker: Gillian
c2.en: He was coming and going through here.
cards: He was coming and|going through here.

c3.speaker: Metal Gear
c3.en: The bathtub has a double bottom. The bottom is actually a lid. Water conceals it from view. To enter or leave, he'd drain all the water into a separate tank.

To enter or leave,|he'd drain all the|water into a|separate tank.

c4.speaker: Gillian
c4.en: That's how much Snatchers hate ultraviolet light. That's why they use the abandoned Tube Liner tunnels.
cards: That's why they use|the abandoned Tube|Liner tunnels.

c5.speaker: Metal Gear
c5.en: Come on, Gillian. Let's get outside.

c7.speaker: Metal Gear
c7.en: He's completely junked. A stubborn one, wasn't he?
cards: He's completely|junked. A stubborn one, wasn't he?

c8.speaker: Gillian
c8.en: He survived that explosion? And got here ahead of us! If they take over the city, there'll be nothing we can do. We have to stop them first.

c9.speaker: Metal Gear
c9.en: Then we must keep the chief away from the summit.

cb.speaker: Metal Gear
cb.en: Let's borrow this taxi and hurry to headquarters.
cards: Let's borrow this|taxi and hurry to headquarters.

cc.speaker: Gillian
cc.en: That's the plan. Mika, old man, please be safe.
